title: Small Group Key West Adult Sunset & Moët Sail & Amazing Cheeses
includes: Bottomless Domain Chandon Brut Classic Champagne (additional champagne upgrades available)
An international selection of premium wines
Ice-cold beers (domestic and imported) & White Claws
requirements: Suitable for all physical fitness levels
Minimum age is 21 years (Adult Only Cruise). Proof of age or ID will be required
Dress - your best Key West casual
This activity requires a waiver to be signed before participating
cancellation: All sales are final. No refund is available for cancellations.
blurb:
Avoid the crowds and Sail on Key West’s beautiful shallow waters on this Adults Only Sunset & Moët cruise, to sip Moët & Chandon champagne and indulge your palate while being washed in the colors of the Key West sunset! 

Included in the tour price is bottomless house champagne Chandon Brut, 8 premium red and white still wines, ice-cold beers & White Claws, and a champagne-inspired Gourmet Cheese Buffet (naturally gluten free) that includes 4 incredible international cheeses, paired plump berry tray, local smoked fish dip, crunchy crisps and fresh-baked crusty bread. Two other Moët & Chandon champagnes are available for additional purchase - both at wholesale price - only for onboard guests. 

Key West is famous for its tropical sunset, and there’s no better way to watch it than on this famous Sunset & Moët Cruise. This public trip is always limited to 14 adult passengers on a 28 person sailing catamaran, for guests comfort and quality control. And NO kids!
